data.title: Fixed editor footprint + zoom-to-one-cell detail editing

data.body: Human-requested changes to the PM-3 scaffold: (1) Changing the pixel/cell size must NOT change the size of the UI — the editor should keep a fixed on-screen footprint and adapt its zoom to the available space; only the resolution changes. (2) Add the ability to zoom in on one box of the 3x3 grid (both modes) to draw in detail while zoomed; needs an enter/exit affordance, and drawing semantics must be preserved while focused (mode 1 center stays locked; mode 2 strokes still wrap into the tile).

Implemented per plan in 3 commits: (1) 4b8f174 fixed footprint — bezel gets definite CSS height, canvas fills its inner box in whole device px, art centered at largest integer device zoom, letterboxed; shared art-rect (z/ox/oy/Lf/fx0/fy0) drives layout+render+toPt; letterbox pointerdown/Alt-pick gated, hover clears there. (2) f2c0a80 focus state + plumbing — AppState.focus (ephemeral), enter/exit/toggle/moveFocus in main.ts (border center rejected with 'center's locked. pick a live cell', arrow center-skip, no wrap at edges, mode switch clears focus), z/Esc/arrow hotkeys, toolbar 'view' group with corner-brackets focus key + LED, LCD focus segment (dim label, — / orange 1-based col·row); grid-editor windows art to the cell, border clamps to cell, tile clamps to one raw cell of margin (never wraps before rasterizing — plotTile's modulo wraps per plotted pixel). (3) cbf6242 polish — focused-tile hover displays wrapped on LCD while tools get raw coords; drawFocusMinimap hairline 3x3 glyph in letterbox corner (orange focused cell, dimmed hollow border-center, skipped when ox<30 && oy<30). No deviations; only the 7 planned files touched (doc/history/persist/tools/raster/preview/export untouched). tsc --noEmit + npm run build green after each step. Code-verified via scratchpad math checks: footprint invariance across cell sizes/DPR, pointer round-trip, letterbox gating, arrow-nav exhaustive walk (center unreachable in border). Need-browser: visual crispness/HiDPI, live previews while focused, undo/redo feel, brand audit — criteria 1-3 math-verified, 4-6/8/11 logic-verified, 7/9/10/12 need manual pass.
